title: dactylorhiza sambucina subsp. siciliensis
intro: Dactylorhiza sambucina subsp. siciliensis, commonly known as Sicilian marsh orchid, is a subspecies of orchid plant. It is a perennial herb that belongs to the genus Dactylorhiza and is native to the Sicily region in Italy. The Sicilian marsh orchid is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial health benefits. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and immune system modulation.
